name: Rusty Sword
description: 90-degree swing arc. Moderate reach, moderate speed.

name: Bone Dagger
description: 60-degree arc. Fastest swing speed. Short reach, shallow digging.

name: Broad Axe
description: 120-degree arc. Long reach. Slow, heavy swing that digs deep.

name: Flame Blade
description: Leaves lava pools on swing. Built-in Lava Emitter.

name: Throwing Knife
description: Single fast straight-flying projectile. Quick cooldown, long lifetime.

name: Fire Orb
description: Slow short-lived orb that explodes on impact, hitting every foe in a small area.

name: Spread Shot
description: Fires 3 projectiles in a 30-degree fan. Covers a wide lane.

name: Boss Staff
description: Single bolt with subtle spread. Longest projectile lifetime.

name: Willowblade
description: Quick swings on tap. Charged thrust spawns a blade wave.

name: Flame Sword
description: Hits set foes on fire. Leaves lava pools behind the wielder.

name: Frost Sword
description: Wide arc. Hits chill foes.

name: Qinggang Light Sword
description: Alternating up-and-down swings.

name: Blood Blade
description: Full charge unleashes a rapid burst of lunging swings that carry the wielder forward.

name: Tao Sword
description: Heavy greatsword. Slow wide swings.

name: Dragon Fang
description: Three fast thrusts per use. Skewers straight ahead without slowing movement.

name: Heavenly Sword
description: Wide frost-touched swings. Kills release a frost burst that chills nearby foes.

name: Grand Knight's Sword
description: Three-hit combo: two arcing slashes, then a thrust.

name: Deep Dark Blade
description: Forward spin into a grounded thrust.

name: Broadsword
description: Wide swing across everything ahead. Holding the attack slows movement.

name: Executioner
description: Tap for a single chop. Charge for up to two spinning slashes. Short reach, quick wind-up.

name: Void Sword
description: Charge drags nearby enemies inward. Release cuts them in a single arc.

name: Caliburn
description: Long reach. Every third swing fires a sword beam.

name: Phantom Blade
description: Upward slash into a forward thrust. The edge passes through enemy guard.

name: Iron Mace
description: Blunt head. Hits stun. Slow swing that digs deep.

name: Rapier
description: Thrusting blade. Very fast. Pierces every foe in a narrow line.

name: Bone Cleaver
description: Wide front arc. Hits all foes ahead.

name: War Scythe
description: Sweeps a full 300-degree arc. Hits flanks and rear.

name: Jack and Mary
description: Strikes twice per swing: one to the front, one to the back.

name: Obsidian Greatsword
description: Cleaves terrain. Slowest, heaviest swing. The deepest digger of any weapon.

name: Venom Fang Blade
description: Long darting lunge. Very fast, shallow digging.

name: Tide Caller
description: Hits apply Wet status. Vulnerable to freeze and shock.

name: Cinder Brand
description: Kills burst into flame, igniting nearby foes.

name: Glacier Edge
description: Heavy blade. Slow swing. Hits chill foes; hitting an already-chilled foe freezes it.

name: Katana
description: Each swing is a short dash-slash. A kill during the dash refunds the cooldown.

name: Gravedigger's Spade
description: Digs through terrain. Doubles as a blunt weapon.

name: Reaper's Glaive
description: Long reach. Each kill has a 1/10 chance to restore 1 health.

name: Berserker's Axe
description: Swings faster the less armor you have left.

name: Mirror Blade
description: Swings deflect incoming projectiles.

name: Whirlwind Blade
description: Charged spin strikes every foe around the wielder.

name: Quake Hammer
description: Charged slam sends a shockwave outward, flinging back nearby enemies.

name: Soul Reaver
description: Kills grant stacking reach and arc. Stacks decay when combat ends.

name: Heavy Crossbow
description: Single bolt pierces through multiple enemies in a line.

name: Scatter Blunderbuss
description: Wide cone of short-range pellets.

name: Arc Railgun
description: Charged rail-shot. Pierces everything in a line. Longer charge makes a longer, wider beam.

name: Flame Lobber
description: Lobs pots that shatter into lava pools on impact.

name: Frost Repeater
description: Fastest fire rate. Every shot applies freeze.

name: Venom Spitter
description: Spits globs that leave caustic pools on impact.

name: Tesla Gun
description: Lightning bolts that chain from foe to foe.

name: Chakram Launcher
description: Spinning chakram flies out and returns. Hits twice per throw.

name: Seeker Launcher
description: Missiles that track and chase targets around cover.

name: Hailstorm Bow
description: Single pull fans into a volley of arrows across a wide area.
